question: Who is the author of the book 'Marx's Revenge: The Resurgence of Capitalism and the Death of Statist Socialism'?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Meghnad Desai**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Meghnad Desai** is the author of the book "**Marx's Revenge: The Resurgence of Capitalism and the Death of Statist Socialism**," which explores the resurgence of capitalism and the decline of socialism.
 
• The book argues against conventional Marxist interpretations, suggesting that capitalism has proven to be a more resilient and adaptable system than originally anticipated by Karl Marx.
 
• **Meghnad Desai** is a renowned economist and academic based in the **United Kingdom**. He is known for his critical approach toward economic systems and has published numerous works on political economy and global economics.
 
• The book was published in **2002** and has received significant attention for its bold analysis of economic ideologies and systems.
 
• This work demonstrates Desai's ability to critically assess the evolution of socio-economic systems in the context of globalization and neoliberalism.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Meghnad Desai:**

 
 
• Born in **Vadodara, India**, Meghnad Desai pursued higher education in economics and later moved to the **United Kingdom**.
 
• He served as a professor at the **London School of Economics** and is known for his expertise in political economy.
 
• He has been awarded several honors for his contributions to economics, including the prestigious **Padma Bhushan** by the Government of India.
 
 
 
• **Marx’s Revenge:**
 
 
• The book critiques the failure of **statist socialism** and how capitalism has emerged stronger in a globalized world.
 
• It discusses the adaptability of capitalism and suggests that Marx's predictions about its collapse may have been premature.
 
• Desai presents a nuanced analysis of the global economic system, incorporating historical and contemporary perspectives.
 
 
 
• **Capitalism vs Socialism:**
 
 
• Capitalism is an economic system characterized by **private ownership**, free markets, and profit-driven enterprises.
 
• Socialism advocates for **state ownership** of resources and aims to reduce income inequality.
 
• Desai's book examines the inherent flaws in socialism and its inability to keep pace with the dynamic nature of capitalism.
 
 
 
• **Other Works by Meghnad Desai:**
 
 
• Desai has authored several influential books, including "**Development and Nationhood**" and "**Rethinking Islamism**."
 
• His writings often focus on the intersection of economics, politics, and globalization.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Amartya Sen:**

 
 
• A Nobel Prize-winning economist known for his work on **welfare economics** and development theory.
 
• Sen has written books like "**Development as Freedom**" and "**The Idea of Justice**" but is not the author of "**Marx’s Revenge**."
 
 
 
• **Pavan K. Varma:**
 
 
• An Indian author and diplomat known for his works on Indian culture and history, such as "**The Great Indian Middle Class**."
 
• He does not specialize in political economy or Marxist analysis.
 
 
 
• **Ramachandra Guha:**
 
 
• A renowned historian and environmentalist, Guha has authored books like "**India After Gandhi**" but does not focus on economic systems or Marxist critiques.
